unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U19: Apply constructive notice and qualified indoor-management protection

payload.title: Public powers and internal regularity are different checks
payload.core_explanation_md:
Constructive notice treats a person dealing with the company as knowing the relevant public constitutional documents and their proper meaning. It prevents an outsider simply relying on not having read an express public limit. Indoor management addresses internal regularity where the transaction is otherwise within the relevant capacity and apparent authority.

The protection is qualified. Actual knowledge of irregularity and acts outside the officer apparent authority defeat the shortcut described in the source; suspicious circumstances also call for inquiry. A lender should read the public constitution and respond to warning signs, while avoiding a blanket assertion that every unseen internal formality always invalidates an otherwise qualifying transaction.

self_check.prompt_text: Does indoor management authorise ignoring a known internal defect?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Actual knowledge is a material exception.

payload.stem_md: The lender knows the required approval was refused, but relies on indoor management to assume it exists. What defeats that reasoning?

options.explanation_md: The doctrine is not a licence to ignore known facts.

options.text_md: The fact the borrower is incorporated
options.explanation_md: Incorporation alone does not remove the exception.

options.text_md: The lender never needs to examine any public document

payload.correct_explanation_md: The doctrine is not a licence to ignore known facts.

payload.stem_md: An officer acts outside apparent authority and invokes indoor management as a universal cure. Which boundary matters?

options.text_md: Only whether the officer has a business card
options.explanation_md: A card is not unlimited authority.

options.text_md: Every internal act is automatically protected
The outsider can disregard the company objects

options.explanation_md: Internal regularity protection does not create unlimited authority.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Internal regularity protection does not create unlimited authority.
